purpose: See all items of one kind, scan, and open or manage one.
layout: Title, then search or segmented filter, then dense rows (leading icon or thumbnail, title, secondary line, trailing value or chevron). Group with section headers when the data has natural groups (date, status).

required: Rows with leading visual, title, secondary line and trailing value

primaryAction.note: "Add" as an icon button in the header, or a floating button when adding is the core loop.

avoid: Rows without a trailing value or state
